title: Not a Swiss Army Knife: Academics’ Perceptions of Trade-Offs around Generative AI Use

bias_targets.methodology: Thematic analysis of semi-structured interviews with academic knowledge workers detailing their concerns about societal biases present in AI training data and its impact on students of color.
Thematic analysis of semi-structured interviews capturing participants' concerns regarding gender biases inadvertently perpetuated and amplified by generative AI models.

Qualitative evaluation of interview responses highlighting concerns over general cultural insensitivity and the overrepresentation of WEIRD (Western, Educated, Industrialized, Rich, Democratic) perspectives in training data.

Thematic analysis of participants' perceptions regarding the digital divide, social class divides, and inequalities stemming from unequal access to high-speed internet and AI tools in low-resource environments.

Qualitative analysis of participant interviews discussing the dual potential of AI to either aid users with disabilities (e.g., visual impairments) or perpetuate existing disability biases found in training data.
